integrity: An exhaustive finite certificate in two modular images and exact quadratic kernel witnesses over Q(sqrt(3)) is provided in full. No stronger claim than the displayed recovery thresholds and four defect orbits is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only exact, noiseless evaluation of harmonics of degree at most two on the specified fourteen radially normalized vertices; no stability, noisy recovery or general-node theorem. Priority comparison is bounded and independent validation has not occurred.
title: Sharp eleven-sample recovery and four exceptional erasure types on the rhombic dodecahedron
